title: CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report (2023 release; CCNs 310038 and 310070)
scope: All returned 2023-release report rows filtered by CMS Provider CCN for RWJUH New Brunswick (310038) and Saint Peter’s University Hospital (310070).

rights.source_license: U.S. government data; CMS dataset API public access
rights.redistribution: factual public rows retained with CMS attribution

limits: Annual Medicare cost-report filings are retrospective and may have differing fiscal-year begin/end dates.
The same CCN may have multiple report records/statuses; inspect report IDs and status before selecting one.
Beds/FTE/utilization are reported fields, not current staffed capacity, available beds or hourly throughput.
Reported charges, expenses, costs and payment fields have distinct accounting meanings and do not establish patient liability.
CMS notes data are contractor-extracted from provider submissions; users must interpret fields with the CMS methodology and dictionary.
